image:image.image:title: Hostal Bellavista
image:image.image:caption: Hostal y restaurante en primera línea del puerto

image:image.image:title: Habitación Económica
image:image.image:caption: Una habitación acogedora y cómoda para dos personas, con vistas a nuestro patio interior y una decoración moderna y fresca. Equipada con cama doble o dos camas individuales, baño privado, aire acondicionado y escritorio de madera.

image:image.image:title: Habitación Doble Estándar
image:image.image:caption: Habitación exterior para dos personas con vistas a la calle. Dispone de cama doble o dos camas individuales, baño privado con bañera, aire acondicionado, escritorio de madera y un amplio armario.

image:image.image:title: Habitación Vista Puerto
image:image.image:caption: Nuestra habitación estrella: amplia, luminosa y con preciosas vistas al puerto de La Savina. Dispone de cama doble, sofá, baño privado con bañera y complementos, aire acondicionado, escritorio de madera y un amplio armario.

image:image.image:caption: Apartamento en el puerto de La Savina con dos habitaciones, baño, cocina, salón y una gran terraza. Ideal para familias o dos parejas.

image:image.image:caption: Hostal and restaurant on the first line of the port

image:image.image:title: Economy Room
image:image.image:caption: A comfortable, welcoming room for two, looking onto our inner courtyard, with fresh modern decoration. It has a double bed or twin beds, private bathroom, air conditioning and a wooden desk.

image:image.image:title: Standard Double Room
image:image.image:caption: An outward-facing room for two with a view over the street. It has a double bed or twin beds, a private bathroom with bathtub, air conditioning, a wooden desk and a large wardrobe.

image:image.image:title: Port View Room
image:image.image:caption: Our finest room: spacious, bright and with beautiful views over the port of La Savina. It has a double bed, a sofa, a private bathroom with bathtub and toiletries, air conditioning, a wooden desk and a large wardrobe.

image:image.image:title: Can Loca Apartment — Es Pujols
image:image.image:caption: A seafront apartment in Es Pujols with one double bedroom, a living room with sofa bed, kitchen, bathroom and terrace.

image:image.image:caption: An apartment in the port of La Savina with two bedrooms, bathroom, kitchen, living room and a large terrace. Ideal for families or two couples.
